hookups.source: https://www.highpointnc.gov/2769/Campground ('Sections A, B, C Full service - water, sewer, cable access and Wi-Fi. Electrical hook ups vary by site - 30 or 50 amps'; 'Section D Water, sewer, 30 amps'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The campground page says 103 full-hookup RV sites and 13 tent platforms; the city's 2024 FAQ says 107 full-service sites plus 13 platforms.

sites.source: https://www.highpointnc.gov/2769/Campground ('There are 103 RV sites-full hook up and 13 tent platforms') + https://www.highpointnc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/26566/Oak-Hollow-Campground-FAQs-2024 ('107 full-service campsites ... in addition to 13 (15'x15') tent platforms'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.highpointnc.gov/2769/Campground ('Bathhouses, Camp Store, Fishing, Laundry Facility (open seasonally), Outdoor Pool'; Sections A-C 'cable access and Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.highpointnc.gov/2769/Campground ('The Oak Hollow Campground is open year-round'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online on Campspot or by phone (336-883-3492, 8 a.m.-7:30 p.m., same-day reservations); 'Several sites available on a first-come, first served basis.' Reservations up to nine months ahead. 'Campers are allowed to stay a maximum of 21 nights within a 30-day period' (then 10 nights away); no long-term camping.

booking.source: https://www.highpointnc.gov/2769/Campground (Reservations section) + https://www.highpointnc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/26566/Oak-Hollow-Campground-FAQs-2024 ('can be reserved up to nine (9) months in advance'; 'We do not offer long-term camping at Oak Hollow. Campers are allowed to stay a maximum of 21 nights within a 30-day period'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of High Point campground on Oak Hollow Lake in the 1,550-acre Oak Hollow Park, gated; many sites border the lake, and Sections A-C have cable TV. The lake is a drinking-water reservoir, so no swimming (campground pool Memorial Day-Labor Day). --Claude
summary: City-run campground. Confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups (Section D 30 amp), 116 sites (103 RV + 13 tent platforms; the 2024 FAQ says 107 RV), wifi, camp store, seasonal laundry, year-round season, Campspot booking with some first-come sites; added the 9-month window and the 21-nights-in-30 maximum. Fees ($35-45 for up to four people) stand as recorded 2026-10-13 and match the city page. Phone 336-883-3492 matches. Note: dropped the site counts and hookup restatement, added the no-swimming caveat.
